overall_reason: The job is scanning three tasks, but the card squeezes a four-column table (Task, Owner, Due, Status) into a 300px card, so every value gets the same weight and nothing reads first.

score.reason: T-SQUINT fails (four even grey columns, no first element), T-DENSITY-FIT fails (four tracks and 22px rows in a 276px body) and T-DELETION finds a header row that restates the values.

findings.where: task card body, tiles/1440-00.png, x 401 to 676, 1440px
findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: four column tracks of 102px (Task), 51px (Owner), 56px (Due) and 51px (Status) share a 276px body, with rows 22px apart (y=73, 95, 117). The text sits at 10 to 12px. The sweep's near_blank hit (PRC-001) finds only 0.09% of pixels differ from the page colour.
findings.before: A four-column data table at full table density inside a small card.
findings.after: Stack owner and due date under the task name as one metadata line, keep status on the right edge, and give each record two lines.
findings.why: A table layout packed into a card leaves 51px tracks, so the owner, date and status read as specks rather than facts.

findings.evidence: In the squint render the card shows four equal grey columns and no heavier element. The task names are 12px/400 and the owner, due and status cells are 11px/400, so size and weight separate nothing. The 14px/550 "Project tasks" header is the only heavier mark.
findings.before: Task name, owner, due date and status all at one weight in one row.
findings.after: Make the task name the primary element of each record and set owner and due date as quieter metadata beneath it.
findings.why: With no first element per row, the reader has to read every cell to find which task is which.

findings.evidence: The 10px header row reads "Task  Owner  Due  Status" above values that name themselves: "Maya", "Today", "Ready".
findings.before: A column header row over three rows of self-explaining values.
findings.after: Delete the header row; the record layout (name, then "owner · due") carries the meaning.
findings.why: Deleting the row loses nothing, so it only adds a fourth band of small grey text.

strengths: The header line "Project tasks" with "3 open" on the right edge gives the card one clear title.
not_investigated: 00-contract.md is absent: no visitor mode, audience or brief overrides; judged as a single product illustration (an app component shown in a frame), with Operate-style rules for the component itself.
T-FIVE-SECOND, T-HEADINGS-READ, T-COMPOSITION-RUN, T-STOCK-ORDER and T-ANATOMY: the artifact is one composition in one 1440x900 tile, not a page with sections, a fold or a visitor job.
The label text above the frame and the plate around it belong to the viewing page, not the composition; they were not judged.
Squint render made with Pillow (GaussianBlur 8) in 03-lenses/squint/ as a viewing aid; no blur_render detector exists.
